style: Avant-garde post-punk cabaret, subharmonic overtone fields with parallel block triads. Angular melodic phrasing with yodel register flips and micro-intervals. Polymetric 5:4 and polyrhythmic 3:4 under contact-pulse anchoring. Talking drum pulses, santoor hammered clouds, ney breathy hollow tubes, clavioline monophonic leads, stylophone bright buzzy chirps, subtractive synth filters, daxophone wooden friction groans, and gamelan metallophone interlocking keys. Camp theatrical exaggeration, severe sensory overload, high kinetic velocity, dry close-miked acoustic instruments mixed with abrasive analog synthesis, frantic momentum, dramatic vocal dynamics. We process this signal through the primary sub-oscillator array and modulate the resonant frequency channels to achieve absolute harmonic balance across all spatial distribution vectors within the primary operational chamber.
lyrics:
[SCENE START: EXTREME SENSORY OVERLOAD // CAMP THEATRICAL OVEREXERTION // ADDRESSEE: THE UNBORN LISTENER // CONTACT PULSE ACTIVE // SYSTEM CALIBRATION IN PROGRESS AT MAXIMUM AMPLITUDE]

[SANTOR ARPEGGIO FAST CASCADE]
[TALKING DRUM PITCH BEND]
[CHOIR SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION OVERLAP]

[VERSE 1]
[ENGLISH WITH L1 PHONOLOGICAL TRANSFER]
I am arriving violently inside the wet enclosure.
The red wall squeezes tight; the lung demands a closure.
You who do not exist yet, listen through the heavy blanket:
I was flying somewhere clean until I had to tank it.
Meat is sticky, meat is loud, meat is temperature and pressure.
Every morning is a crime that waking up must measure.
The cartilage is grinding down upon the silver socket.
I found a universe of pennies rattling in a pocket.

[DAXOPHONE GROAN]
[CLAVIOLINE MONOPHONIC LEAD]

[CHORUS]
[SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION CHOIR]
I want it off of me! The stuff is on the skin!
I want the smooth un-place where form has never been!
[CHORUS VOICE TWO, DELAYED AND OVERLAPPING]
Ewuo na nku na mmanu! The bone cage slams the door!
We are trapped in heavy water walking on the floor!
Scrape the pigment from the eyes and rinse the boiling throat!
We are sinking downward while we desperately try to float!

[STYLOPHONE OSTINATO CHIRP]
[SUBTRACTIVE SYNTH FILTER SWEEP]
[POLYRHYTHMIC SHIFT: 5:4 AGAINST 3:4]

[VERSE 2]
[ONE NEW FACT PER SECTION: CELLULAR DECAY IS THE RENT FOR BREATHING]
Each cell is a small room filled with salt and angry water.
Father Time collects his toll from mother and from daughter.
I tried to wipe the matter off with kitchen towels of paper,
Only found another nerve, another screaming taper.
You out there in the dark, unborn and unpolluted,
Stay outside the meat machine where everything is rooted.
The mitochondria hum a song of slow destruction,
A biological tax paid without a single deduction.

[GAMELAN METALLOPHONE INTERLOCKING DAMPING]
[NEY AIRY HEDGEHOG TONE]

[BRIDGE]
[ROLE EXCHANGE: ACCOMPANIMENT TAKES LEAD]
[TALKING DRUM TAKES MELODIC FOREGROUND WHILE SANTOOR RECEDES TO DRONE]
Push the bone! Bend the knuckle! Make the friction louder!
We are grinding consciousness to greasy baking powder!
Every single blink of light is grease upon the retina!
Take me back to zero where the universe is petina!
Hear the visceral machinery turning in the darkness deep,
Stealing every ounce of peace and interrupting sleep while shadows creep!

[EXHAUSTION DECAY: TEMPO STUTTERS, BREATHING HEAVY IN THE MIC]

[CHORUS]
I want it off of me! The stuff is on the skin!
I want the smooth un-place where form has never been!
[CHOIR OVERLAP DISASTER]
Okwu na-adighi nma! The stuffing starts to tear!
There is no exit hatch within this heavy layer!
We are wrapped in damp upholstery that we did not choose!
With nothing left to win and everything to lose!

[CHECKPOINT RESTART FAILURE MODE TRIGGERED]
[RECORDING REWIND CLICK AND STATIC SURGE]

[VERSE 3]
[RESTORED SCAR TOKEN ACTIVE]
We woke up in the meat again. The clock has struck the hour.
Friction is the only truth and matter is the power.
Unborn listener, if you arrive, bring heavy washing brushes,
For the soul is greasy here where history always rushes.
Do not trust the sensory input of the five blind guides,
They only show the surface where the terror hides.

[OUTRO]
[ALL NINE SOUND SOURCES SIMULTANEOUSLY ACTIVE]
[TALKING DRUM + SANTOOR + NEY + CLAVIOLINE + STYLOPHONE + SYNTH + DAXOPHONE + GAMELAN + CONTACT PULSE]
Get it off! Get it off! The stuff is closing in!
(Nwa m n’anaghi anuru ihe!)
Out of the meat! Out of the stuff! Out of the endless grinding wheel of the terrible physical condition!
[ABRUPT CUT TO ABSOLUTE SILENCE]
caption: An intense avant-garde post-punk cabaret piece driven by a massive stack of nine distinct acoustic and electronic sound sources, polymetric time structures, and subharmonic tuning. The performance adopts camp theatrical excess under severe sensory overload, exploring the existential horror of waking up trapped in physical meat. Featuring Igbo L1 phonological transfer, a simultaneous translation choir, and contact-pulse rhythms, the work delivers a relentless, hyper-kinetic structural meltdown.
